objective: Keep the Intent in use per work tree, so sessions in different worktrees of one clone never switch each other's Intent, while all other state stays shared on the state branch.
scope: User decision: the Intent in use is kept per work tree; all other state stays shared. Today local/active-intent.json lives in the shared state worktree (see packages/runtime/src/state/local.ts, lock.ts:90 and tree.ts from commits 2e519b7 and c0b1b51 on this branch).

result:
result: Each work tree of one clone now keeps its own Intent in use, and all other state stays shared. `bun test packages/runtime` and the type-check, lint and format-check gates pass. `mise run verify` as a whole fails on two tests in `packages/integrations/claude`, which I did not touch.

**How it works**
- The Intent in use is stored under the shared `local/active-intent/` folder, one file per work tree. The file name is a hash of the work tree's root path.
- A new `WorkTree` context reference in `packages/runtime/src/state/local.ts` carries the root for the run. `execute` in `packages/runtime/src/cli/program.ts` sets it, so every reader and `updateState` resolve from the calling work tree. I used this rather than a new parameter because `packages/runtime/src/vcs/record.ts` calls `readOpenState(call.directory)` and `vcs/` is outside my ownership paths. A parameter would have needed a two-line edit there (`record.ts` and the `Pick` type in `pr.ts`).
- With no `WorkTree` set, no Intent is in use. Writing an Intent in use without one fails with `StateIo`.
- A work tree with no choice of its own falls back to today's rule: it resolves the Intent when exactly one is open.
- `intentInUse` now follows that same rule, so `intent list` and `status` show the only open Intent as in use from a work tree that chose nothing. An existing test required this.
- The old shared `local/active-intent.json` is ignored. I removed it from the migration list in `packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts`, and the `intent use` summary now says "in this work tree".
- `docs/decisions.md` line 49 now names only git config `holyagent.stateBranch`, and it states the per-work-tree exception.

**Tests**
- Existing tests adjusted for the new storage: `store.test.ts` provides the work tree and expects the new file layout, and `cli.test.ts` removes the `active-intent` folder.
- New test in `state-branch.test.ts`: three worktrees of one clone. Creating or choosing an Intent in one does not switch another, and a worktree with no choice among two open Intents gets `NoActiveIntent`.
- With the per-work-tree key temporarily replaced by a shared one, the new test fails, so it proves the change. I restored the file afterwards.
